threads.body: [Config] A lower-priority source can claim a nested list even when it is excluded by the outer list's owner. For example, a higher source with `otel.outer[0].name=x` and `otel.outer[0].inner[0]=null` preserves the null item on its own. Adding a lower source with `otel.outer[0].inner[0]=old` assigns `inner` to that source. Extraction then rejects the higher entry because of `inner` and the lower entry because of `outer`, removing the nested list entirely. Stop claiming descendant lists when an ancestor belongs to another source, and add a nested-null regression test.

replies.body: Good catch — fixed in c954a222e5: a source stops claiming nested lists once an enclosing list belongs to another source, so the outer list's owner keeps its nested null item. Added `extractModel_nestedListBelongsToOuterListSource` (histogram `boundaries` inside `views`), which fails on the previous commit.
